source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps affliction and poverty real while preserving the abundance wordplay.
key_decisions.before: that in a severe testing of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their extreme poverty overflowed in the wealth of their generosity.
key_decisions.after: In a severe test of affliction, their overflowing joy and their deep poverty overflowed into a wealth of generosity.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: that in a severe testing of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their extreme poverty overflowed in the wealth of their generosity.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains measure, excess, and voluntary agency.
key_decisions.before: For according to their means, I can testify, and beyond their means, they gave of their own accord,
key_decisions.after: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond their ability, entirely of their own accord,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For according to their means, I can testify, and beyond their means, they gave of their own accord,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps their initiative and service as participation.
key_decisions.before: begging us earnestly for the favor of participating in the ministry to the holy ones,
key_decisions.after: pleading with us insistently for the grace and fellowship of serving the saints.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: begging us earnestly for the favor of participating in the ministry to the holy ones,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the variant-marked love phrase and repeated overflow.
key_decisions.before: But as you abound in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all earnestness, and in the love we have awakened in you—see that you abound in this gracious work also.
key_decisions.after: But just as you overflow in everything—in faith, speech, knowledge, every kind of earnestness, and the love from us that is among you—see that you also overflow in this grace.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But as you abound in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all earnestness, and in the love we have awakened in you—see that you abound in this gracious work also.

key_decisions.before: I say this not as a command, but to test the genuineness of your love by the earnestness of others.
key_decisions.after: I am not saying this as a command, but I am testing the genuineness of your love through the earnestness of others.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I say this not as a command, but to test the genuineness of your love by the earnestness of others.

key_decisions.before: For if the readiness is present, it is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what one does not have.
key_decisions.after: For if the eagerness is present, the gift is acceptable according to what a person has, not according to what the person does not have.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if the readiness is present, it is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what one does not have.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps explicit rejection of burden shifting and aim.
key_decisions.before: For I do not mean that others should be relieved and you burdened,
key_decisions.after: I do not mean that others should have relief while you have affliction, but that there should be equality.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For I do not mean that others should be relieved and you burdened,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves present reciprocity and repeated equality.
key_decisions.before: but that there may be equality. At the present time your abundance meets their need, so that their abundance may also meet your need, that there may be equality.
key_decisions.after: At the present time, your abundance should meet their need, so that their abundance may also meet your need, and in this way there may be equality.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but that there may be equality. At the present time your abundance meets their need, so that their abundance may also meet your need, that there may be equality.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves church appointment and accountable administration.
key_decisions.before: and not only that, but he has been appointed by the churches to travel with us in this gracious work, which is being administered by us for the glory of the Lord himself and to show our readiness.
key_decisions.after: Not only that, but he was also appointed by the churches to travel with us as we administer this gracious gift for the Lord's own glory and to show our eagerness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and not only that, but he has been appointed by the churches to travel with us in this gracious work, which is being administered by us for the glory of the Lord himself and to show our readiness.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps preventive accountability for a large sum.
key_decisions.before: We take this course so that no one should blame us about this generous gift that is being administered by us,
key_decisions.after: We are taking this precaution so that no one can criticize us concerning this generous gift we are administering.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: We take this course so that no one should blame us about this generous gift that is being administered by us,

key_decisions.before: for we aim at what is honorable not only in the sight of the Lord but also in the sight of others.
key_decisions.after: For we take care to do what is honorable not only before the Lord, but also before people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for we aim at what is honorable not only in the sight of the Lord but also in the sight of others.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves distinct roles and the plural church-apostle sense.
key_decisions.before: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for your sake; and as for our brothers and sisters, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
key_decisions.after: As for Titus, he is my partner and coworker for you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for your sake; and as for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
